title: Order state machine
tagline: Status changes are checked backwards, no header means staff powers, and replies show the old status.
lookFor: Look up allowed moves by the CURRENT status: `ALLOWED[current].includes(next)`.
When a role is missing, default to the LEAST powerful one.
After saving, reply with what was saved, not the old copy.
Unknown status names should get a 400.

hints: Read `ALLOWED[to].includes(order.status)`. Which status is the key?
bugs.cause: It asks 'can the new status move to the old one?', which is backwards.

bugs.symptom: Requests without x-role can ship orders
hints: What role does a request with no header get?
bugs.cause: No header means 'staff', so anyone gets staff powers.

hints: Which object is returned after the update?
bugs.cause: It returns the order as it was BEFORE the update.
It's undefined, and using it crashes.
bugs.fix: `if (!(to in ALLOWED)) throw new HttpError(400, 'unknown status')`
